1.gait: Do you think this patient is able to walk normally, or do have some sort of impairment limiting ability to walk?

2.knee-tibia: Do you think this patient is able to perform the heel-shin maneuver normally, or do they have jerkiness of the lower extremity?

3.finger-nose: Do you think this patient is able to perform the finger-nose maneuver normally, or do they have jerkiness of the lower extremity?

4.dysarthria: Do you think this patient is able to speak normally, or do they have some degree of dysarthria or slurring?

5.oculomotor: Do you think this patient has normal eye movements on the physical exam, or do they have abnormalities like slowed pursuit, saccadic intrusions, hypo/hypermetric sacces, or nystagmus?
